arguments.value: This amendment expands Glu Mobile’s license to distribute additional Ice Age 2/"Ice Age: The Meltdown" wireless content, including specific voicetones and premium videos in the U.S. and outside the U.S. It requires Glu to pay Fox a royalty based on gross receipts from those products, starting with the first unit sold, and confirms that Glu cannot use those sales to recoup any Ice Age 2 guarantee from a prior amendment. It also states that any direct-to-consumer revenue Fox earns from these products is not shared with Glu. All other terms of the original agreement remain unchanged.
